sections.title: Contributors to population change in Somerset West and Taunton
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Somerset West and Taunton, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 7,672 people (−4.8%). In total, there were 12,867 births and 20,538 deaths in Somerset West and Taunton between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 15,021 (9.4%). There were 85,890 people entering the area and 70,869 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Somerset West and Taunton of 553 people (−0.3%), as a result of 4,662 people entering the area and 5,215 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Somerset West and Taunton's population of 4,690 (2.9%).as a result of 11,439 people entering the area and 6,749 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
